introduction: Hub lets the owner of an active workspace mint a personal access token (PAT) bound to that workspace by delegating in-process to apikit's own POST <mount>/user/tokens route and then writing a spec-33 binding row, lists a workspace's bound tokens, revokes and unbinds them when the workspace is deleted or found orphaned by an hourly sweep, exposes both operations through `afc tokens create|list --workspace`, and records every binding and every rate-limited binding refusal in the hub audit log.

glossary.binding: A row (token_id, slug, created_at) in spec 33's token_workspace_bindings table tying one apikit PAT to one workspace slug.
glossary.binding sweep: The background loop StartBindingSweep that removes bindings whose token or workspace no longer exists.
glossary.bound token: A PAT (CredentialType "pat") whose token id has a binding row; S denotes its bound slug.
glossary.delegation: Serving an in-memory POST <mount>/user/tokens request through the configured apikit http.Handler (server.Echo() in production) and capturing the response in memory.
glossary.live token: A pats row with revoked_at NULL; revoking sets revoked_at = apikit.NowUTC() on rows where revoked_at IS NULL.
glossary.mount: The API group prefix (production /api/v1), derived per request as the matched route template c.Path() with the suffix /workspaces/:slug/tokens removed.
glossary.refusal observer: The process-wide function registered in internal/wsaccess that receives one report per request refused because of a binding.
glossary.suppressed: The metadata count on a hub.token.bound_refused event of reports for the same token held back by the rate limit since the previous emitted event.

requirements.title: Who may mint a bound token, checked in order
requirements.rationale: Only the owner of an active workspace may create credentials confined to it, and a bound or admin credential must never mint one.

criteria.action: register POST /workspaces/:slug/tokens and GET /workspaces/:slug/tokens through RegisterRoutes(api *echo.Group, cfg Config) with Config{DB *sql.DB, APIKit http.Handler, Audit audit.Emitter}, called by cmd/af-hub/main.go right after workspace.MountWorkspaceHandlers with server.APIGroup(), server.Echo() and the audit emitter, so both routes run behind apikit authentication and spec 33's binding guard

criteria.condition: POST /workspaces/:slug/tokens arrives without a credential (apikit.GetAuthInfo returns nil)
criteria.action: refuse the request without contacting apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 401 with message authentication required

criteria.condition: a PAT bound to any workspace, including the path's own slug, reaches the mint handler
criteria.action: refuse the request without contacting apikit and report the refusal to the refusal observer with status 403 and surface api
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to workspace <S>; no pats row is created

criteria.condition: the binding lookup for a PAT caller of the mint handler returns a database error
criteria.action: refuse the request without contacting apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

criteria.condition: an admin token calls POST /workspaces/:slug/tokens
criteria.action: refuse the request without contacting apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with message admin tokens cannot mint bound tokens; a real user is required as the token's owner

criteria.condition: the workspace does not exist, wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace denies the caller, or the workspace's owner_id differs from auth.UserID
criteria.action: refuse the request without contacting apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with message workspace not found

criteria.condition: the caller owns the workspace but its status is not active
criteria.action: refuse the request without contacting apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with message workspace is not active

criteria.action: apply the checks of 34-REQ-1.2 through 34-REQ-1.7 in that order, answer with the first failing check, perform no tokens:manage check of its own, and delegate to apikit only when every check passes
criteria.contract: for any caller and workspace state, apikit's handler is invoked exactly when all six checks pass

requirements.title: Minting through apikit's own route
requirements.rationale: Delegation keeps apikit's validation, expiry and privilege-escalation rules unchanged because apikit's PAT handler cannot be imported.

criteria.condition: every check of 34-REQ-1 passes
criteria.action: build an in-process request POST <mount>/user/tokens carrying the caller's original body unchanged, the caller's Authorization header verbatim plus Content-Type and Content-Length, and the caller's request context, serve it with Config.APIKit and capture the response in memory
criteria.contract: apikit's handler receives exactly one request whose body bytes equal the caller's

criteria.action: for any route template ending in /workspaces/:slug/tokens, use as the inner path the template with that suffix removed followed by /user/tokens
criteria.contract: template /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/tokens yields /api/v1/user/tokens; template /x/workspaces/:slug/tokens yields /x/user/tokens

criteria.condition: apikit answers the inner request with any status other than 201 (a bad body, an unknown scope, a missing tokens:manage, a PAT requesting scopes it does not hold, or a bad expires)
criteria.action: copy apikit's status, Content-Type and body to the caller unchanged, write no binding and emit no event
criteria.contract: the caller's status and body are byte-identical to apikit's; token_workspace_bindings is unchanged; no hub.token.bind event

criteria.condition: apikit answers 201 with a body that cannot be decoded or has an empty token_id or token
criteria.action: revoke the token when a token_id is known, write no binding, and log the token_id only
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message failed to bind the token to the workspace; the token's pats row, when one exists, has revoked_at set

requirements.title: Writing the binding, answering, and rolling back
requirements.rationale: A failed bind must never leave a live unbound token, which would reach every workspace of its owner.

criteria.condition: apikit answers 201 with a decodable body carrying a non-empty token_id and token
criteria.action: insert the binding row (token_id, slug, created_at = apikit.NowUTC()) through an internal/wsaccess store function that writes the row only if the workspaces row for slug still exists
criteria.contract: exactly one token_workspace_bindings row for the token_id naming slug

criteria.condition: the binding insert succeeds
criteria.action: answer with token_id, token, name, permissions, expires_at and created_at taken from apikit's response and workspace set to the slug
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with header Cache-Control: no-store and JSON body {token_id, token, name, permissions, workspace, expires_at, created_at}

criteria.condition: the workspace row no longer exists when the binding is inserted, including when a concurrent workspace deletion commits between apikit's 201 and the insert
criteria.action: revoke the token by setting revoked_at = apikit.NowUTC() on its pats row where revoked_at IS NULL before answering, and write no binding
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with message workspace not found; the token's pats row has revoked_at set

criteria.condition: the binding insert returns a database error or a primary-key conflict
criteria.action: revoke the token before answering
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message failed to bind the token to the workspace; the token's pats row has revoked_at set

criteria.condition: revoking the token after a failed bind also fails
criteria.action: log both errors at error level with the token_id and keep the answer of 34-REQ-2.4, 34-REQ-3.3 or 34-REQ-3.4
criteria.contract: the status and message are unchanged by the revocation failure

criteria.action: never write the plaintext token, the body of apikit's 201 response or the Authorization header to any log, and return the plaintext token only in the 201 body of 34-REQ-3.2
criteria.contract: captured log output for every success and failure path contains neither the token string nor the Authorization value

criteria.action: for any failure injected after apikit's 201 (undecodable body, vanished workspace, insert error, key conflict), leave the minted token with revoked_at set and no binding row when the response is written, unless the revocation itself failed
criteria.contract: the response status is 404 or 500, the token's pats row has revoked_at set and token_workspace_bindings has no row for its token_id

requirements.title: Listing a workspace's bound tokens
requirements.rationale: An owner needs to see which credentials can reach a workspace, including revoked and expired ones.

criteria.condition: GET /workspaces/:slug/tokens arrives without a credential
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 401 with message authentication required

criteria.condition: a bound PAT reaches the list handler
criteria.action: refuse the request and report the refusal to the refusal observer with status 403 and surface api
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to workspace <S>; a binding lookup error answers HTTP 500 internal server error

criteria.condition: an unbound PAT holding neither tokens:read nor tokens:manage calls the list handler
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with message PAT requires tokens:read scope

criteria.condition: the workspace does not exist, or the caller is neither an admin token nor the workspace's owner
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with message workspace not found

criteria.condition: an admin token or the owner lists the tokens of an active or archived workspace
criteria.action: return every binding of the slug joined with its pats row, revoked and expired tokens included, ordered by the pats created_at and then token_id, and omit bindings whose pats row is gone
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with a JSON array of {token_id, name, permissions, workspace, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at}; [] when nothing matches

criteria.action: render permissions as the decoded JSON array ([] when the stored value cannot be decoded), render expires_at and revoked_at as null when unset, and never include the token, secret_hash or any other secret field

criteria.condition: the listing query returns a database error
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

requirements.title: Deleting a workspace retires its bound tokens
requirements.rationale: A deleted binding beside a live token would turn it into an unbound PAT with reach over every workspace of its owner.

criteria.condition: deleteWorkspace runs for a slug
criteria.action: inside its existing transaction and before deleting the workspace row, read the token ids bound to the slug, set revoked_at = apikit.NowUTC() on those pats rows where revoked_at IS NULL, and delete every binding row of the slug
criteria.contract: after commit no binding names the slug and every pats row bound to it has revoked_at set

criteria.condition: the workspace being deleted has no binding rows
criteria.action: issue no statement against the pats table
criteria.contract: deleteWorkspace succeeds on a database that has no pats table

criteria.condition: reading the bindings, revoking the tokens or deleting the bindings fails
criteria.action: roll back the whole transaction so the workspace, its bindings and its tokens are unchanged
criteria.contract: DELETE /workspaces/:slug answers HTTP 500 with message failed to delete workspace; the workspace row still exists

criteria.condition: a workspace deletion commits
criteria.action: add the metadata key revoked_tokens to the hub.workspace.delete event, holding the sorted ids of the tokens this deletion revoked
criteria.contract: metadata.revoked_tokens is a sorted string array, [] when the deletion revoked none; tokens already revoked before the deletion are not listed

criteria.condition: a workspace is archived or reactivated
criteria.action: leave its binding rows and the bound tokens' pats rows unchanged
criteria.contract: token_workspace_bindings and pats contents are equal before and after

criteria.condition: a token's workspace has been deleted
criteria.action: refuse every further request carrying that token at apikit's REST authentication and at the git server
criteria.contract: HTTP 401 on REST routes; the git server refuses authentication

criteria.action: create the binding table during workspace schema initialisation through spec 33's idempotent schema function, so deleteWorkspace can read bindings on every database the workspace schema initialises

requirements.title: The binding sweep
requirements.rationale: A binding whose workspace vanished by another path would make a recreated slug reachable, and bindings of purged tokens are dead weight.

criteria.condition: StartBindingSweep(ctx, db) is called
criteria.action: run one pass at once and then one pass per interval (one hour by default, held in a package variable tests may shorten) until ctx is cancelled, then return
criteria.contract: the function returns within one interval after ctx is cancelled

criteria.condition: a sweep pass runs
criteria.action: in one transaction revoke the live tokens of bindings whose slug has no workspaces row and delete those bindings, then delete bindings whose token_id has no pats row
criteria.contract: after the pass no binding names a missing workspace or a missing pats row, and the tokens of the removed orphan-workspace bindings have revoked_at set

criteria.condition: a sweep pass finds bindings of revoked or expired tokens whose workspace still exists
criteria.action: keep those bindings
criteria.contract: 34-REQ-4.5 continues to list them

criteria.condition: a sweep pass fails
criteria.action: roll back the pass, log the error at error level and run again at the next tick
criteria.contract: the loop keeps running; no partial pass is committed

criteria.condition: ctx is cancelled while a pass is running
criteria.action: stop without logging the interrupted pass as a failure
criteria.contract: no error-level log line for the interrupted pass

criteria.action: start StartBindingSweep with go after the binding table exists, so that the sweep never blocks or fails hub start-up

requirements.title: afc tokens create --workspace
requirements.rationale: The agent-fox operator needs one command that mints a workspace-bound credential and shows it once.

criteria.action: register in BuildRootCommand, in place of apikit.TokensCmd(), a hub TokensCmd that takes apikit's tokens command, finds its create and list subcommands, adds a --workspace string flag to each and wraps their RunE (or Run when RunE is nil)
criteria.contract: a unit test fails when apikit's tokens command lacks a create or list subcommand

criteria.condition: afc tokens create runs without --workspace
criteria.action: run apikit's own create behaviour unchanged
criteria.contract: the request, output and exit code equal apikit's

criteria.condition: afc tokens create is given an empty --workspace value, a missing or empty --name, or a --permissions value that is missing or holds no entry after splitting on commas, trimming and dropping empty entries
criteria.action: stop before sending any request
criteria.contract: exit code 2; the hub receives no request

criteria.condition: afc tokens create runs with a non-empty --workspace, --name and --permissions
criteria.action: send POST /workspaces/<slug>/tokens with body {name, permissions, expires} (permissions the cleaned list, expires the --expires value), print the response as one JSON document on stdout and write one warning line on stderr saying the token will not be shown again
criteria.contract: exit code 0; stdout parses as one JSON object; stderr holds exactly one warning line

criteria.condition: the hub refuses the create request
criteria.action: show the hub's error message
criteria.contract: exit code 1

criteria.condition: no API key is configured or the hub is unreachable
criteria.action: report the error the same way apikit's other commands do
criteria.contract: exit code 2

requirements.title: afc tokens list --workspace
requirements.rationale: The operator needs to see which tokens a workspace has issued without seeing any secret.

criteria.condition: afc tokens list runs without --workspace
criteria.action: run apikit's own list behaviour unchanged
criteria.contract: the request, output and exit code equal apikit's

criteria.condition: afc tokens list runs with a non-empty --workspace
criteria.action: send GET /workspaces/<slug>/tokens and print the returned array as one JSON document on stdout, containing no token or secret_hash field
criteria.contract: exit code 0; stdout parses as one JSON array

criteria.condition: afc tokens list is given an empty --workspace value
criteria.action: stop before sending any request
criteria.contract: exit code 2; the hub receives no request

criteria.condition: the hub refuses the list request
criteria.action: show the hub's error message
criteria.contract: exit code 1

requirements.title: The hub.token.bind audit event
requirements.rationale: Every credential hub confines to a workspace must be traceable in the workspace's audit log.

criteria.action: define the constants EventTokenBind = "hub.token.bind" and EventTokenBoundRefused = "hub.token.bound_refused" with doc comments in internal/audit/types.go

criteria.condition: a binding insert of 34-REQ-3.1 commits
criteria.action: emit exactly one event with event_type hub.token.bind, resource_type token, resource_id the token_id, action bind, workspace the slug, actor the caller's user id and credential type, and metadata {token_id, workspace, permissions, expires_at} taken from apikit's response with expires_at null when the token has no expiry
criteria.contract: one hub.token.bind row per successful mint

criteria.action: emit hub.token.bind on a context derived with context.WithoutCancel from the request context, so a caller disconnect does not cancel the emission

criteria.condition: the mint request is refused, passed through from apikit, or rolled back
criteria.action: emit no hub.token.bind event
criteria.contract: zero hub.token.bind events for that request

criteria.condition: Config.Audit is nil or Emit returns an error
criteria.action: skip emission when nil, log the error otherwise, and send the success response unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with the body of 34-REQ-3.2

requirements.title: Reporting binding refusals as hub.token.bound_refused
requirements.rationale: Refused attempts by a bound token are a signal of misuse or leakage, but a flood must not swamp the audit log.

criteria.action: provide one function to register a process-wide refusal observer and one to report a refusal, both safe for concurrent use, with reporting a no-op when no observer is registered, and without importing internal/audit
criteria.contract: reporting with no observer registered returns without effect

criteria.action: carry in each report the token id, the token's user id when the refusal point has authenticated the token, the bound slug, the requested slug when the request named one, the method, the route template (the git route for git), the status (403 or 404) and the surface (api or git)

criteria.condition: a request is refused because of a binding at any refusal point of spec 33 (binding guard, apikit route guard, wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace, lookupWorkspaceForAuth, the git server, session and audit refusals) or at 34-REQ-1.3 or 34-REQ-4.2
criteria.action: call the report function exactly once for that request, and never call it for list filtering that is not a refusal
criteria.contract: one report per refused request

criteria.condition: the reporter registered by cmd/af-hub/main.go receives a report whose token has no event emitted in the last minute
criteria.action: emit one event with event_type hub.token.bound_refused, resource_type token, resource_id the token_id, action refuse, workspace the bound slug, actor type pat, actor id the user id (empty when not supplied), and metadata {token_id, bound_workspace, requested_workspace (only when present), method, route, status, surface, suppressed}
criteria.contract: one hub.token.bound_refused row

criteria.condition: a report arrives less than one minute after the last event emitted for the same token
criteria.action: emit nothing and increment that token's held-back count, which becomes the suppressed value of the token's next emitted event and is reset after it
criteria.contract: suppressed is 0 when nothing was held back

criteria.action: for any sequence of timestamped reports, emit events for one token at least one minute apart, with each event's suppressed equal to the number of that token's reports since its previous emitted event
drop per-token limiter entries older than the one-minute window so memory stays bounded by the tokens refused within the last minute, and accept an injected clock for tests
never place the token string or the Authorization header in an event or a log line

execution_paths.title: An owner mints a bound token from the CLI

steps.action: runs afc tokens create --workspace S --name svc --permissions workspaces:read with an API key
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/S/tokens with {name, permissions, expires: 90}
passes the credential, binding, admin, ownership and active checks
serves POST /api/v1/user/tokens in-process through server.Echo() with the caller's body and Authorization header
creates the pats row and answers 201 with token_id and token
inserts the token_workspace_bindings row for S
emits hub.token.bind and answers 201 with Cache-Control: no-store
prints the JSON document on stdout and one warning line on stderr

execution_paths.title: An owner lists a workspace's bound tokens

steps.action: runs afc tokens list --workspace S
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/S/tokens
checks credential, binding, scope and ownership, then joins bindings with pats
prints the array of tokens without any secret

execution_paths.title: Deleting a workspace revokes its bound tokens

steps.action: archives S, then sends DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/S
in one transaction reads S's bindings, revokes the live pats rows, deletes the bindings and then the workspace row
emits hub.workspace.delete with metadata revoked_tokens
sends a request with the formerly bound token
answers 401

execution_paths.title: A bound token is refused and the refusal is audited

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/X/patches with a token bound to S
answers 404 workspace not found and calls the wsaccess report function
emits hub.token.bound_refused with suppressed 0
repeats the request within the minute
holds back the event and increments the token's suppressed count

execution_paths.title: The sweep cleans up orphaned bindings

steps.action: starts StartBindingSweep with go after the binding table exists
runs a pass at once in one transaction
revokes and unbinds tokens whose workspace row is gone and deletes bindings whose pats row is gone
